name: Jana Jeggle
headline: Chief of Staff @buycycle | CDTM | MIT | TUM
major: MSc Management and Technology (TUM), BSc Business administration (WWU Münster, Dublin Business School)
summary:
👋 Hi - I'm Jana.
I'm German & studied "Management and Technology" at TU Munich and CDTM. I'm passionate about working on great, complex products and building companies people truly love working for. I've had the chance to learn and contribute in both EdTech, FinTech and marketplace startups, at various stages. 

🚴‍♂️ As Chief of Staff at buycycle I support the team in building the number one marketplace for pre-owned, high value performance bikes. You are looking for a road bike or want to get rid of your old one without any hustle? - with buycycle.com your dream bike might be just 2 clicks away!

🤓 I’m passionate about female entrepreneurship and conducted research on "male allyship for female entrepreneurs" at TUM and MIT, aiming to make entrepreneurship more inclusive. We need so many more female founders out there. Through my research I'm trying to understand what role male allies can/should play in the journey of a female founder. 

🚀 Let's Chat!
Interested in these areas or just want to exchange ideas? I'd love to connect. Just hit me up!
